summary: Recent updates to the image decoding capabilities in Firefox focus on refining how the browser handles image requests and responses. A notable change is the improved management of responses from service workers, specifically ensuring that responses from the same origin are treated correctly when replacing cross-origin requests, which enhances security and functionality. Additionally, there has been a move towards unifying certain promise handling within the code, which aims to streamline the processing of asynchronous tasks related to image decoding. Overall, these changes contribute to better performance and reliability of image handling in the browser, ensuring a smoother experience for users.
